summary.text: Kenneth Collins is a Republican member of the Kansas House of Representatives representing District 2 (Crawford County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the House since 2019.

paragraphs.text: Kenneth Collins is listed as a member of the Insurance Committee, the Local Government Committee, the Transportation Committee and the Veterans and Military Committee.
The Legislature lists Kenneth Collins's occupation as Convenience Store Owner.
